boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Mary's College of California
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with directly verified evening availability in Moraga, on campus, or nearby Lamorinda.

cards.title: Oliver Hall Late Night
cards.subtitle: Saint Mary's College campus, Moraga
cards.notes: Check the dining-hours page before leaving; the listed academic-year late-night window runs 9–11 p.m. on designated nights.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus dining hall has a documented late-night program.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists Oliver Hall late-night dining from 9:00–11:00 p.m. on Sunday through Thursday during the academic-year schedule.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year schedule lists Late Night 9:00–11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; the page says hours may change during breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Café Louis Evening Stop
cards.subtitle: Saint Mary's College campus, Moraga
cards.notes: Use the posted schedule to time an evening coffee or snack run; verify holiday and break adjustments before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop with documented weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's dining information lists Café Louis open until 9:00 p.m. Monday through Friday during the cited academic-year schedule.
cards.access_notes: The posted schedule lists Monday–Friday hours until 9:00 p.m.; verify changes during break periods or holidays.

cards.entity_name: JustBaked machine at De La Salle Hall
cards.title: JustBaked at De La Salle
cards.subtitle: Ground floor of De La Salle Hall, Saint Mary's campus
cards.notes: Keep this automated campus option in mind when staffed locations are closed; use available Flex Dollars or another accepted payment method.
cards.short_summary: A documented 24/7 hot-food machine on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: A Saint Mary's family newsletter states that the JustBaked machine on De La Salle's ground floor provides hot food options 24/7.
cards.source_title: Saint Mary's College Family Newsletter — December 2025
cards.access_notes: The College newsletter describes the JustBaked machine as providing hot-food options 24/7.

cards.title: Nation's Moraga Until 10
cards.subtitle: 400 Park Street, Moraga
cards.notes: Confirm the daily listing before making the trip; the restaurant’s location page currently posts service through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Moraga food stop with a directly posted 10 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Nation's official locations page lists its Moraga restaurant at 400 Park Street as open daily from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Find a Nation's | Nation’s Giant Hamburgers
cards.access_notes: Official location listing: daily 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Round Table on Rheem
cards.subtitle: 361 Rheem Boulevard, Moraga
cards.notes: For the latest Friday or Saturday pickup window, select the Moraga location in the official ordering page before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A Moraga pizza counter whose official ordering page posts 10 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Round Table's Moraga ordering page lists Friday and Saturday open hours until 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists Friday 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. and Saturday 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Nation's Orinda Late Window
cards.subtitle: 65 Moraga Way, Orinda
cards.notes: Check the day before traveling from campus: this location’s official listing shows a later close than the Moraga location on every day.
cards.short_summary: An Orinda food destination with posted service through 11 p.m. or midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Nation's official locations page lists the Orinda restaurant open until 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Find a Nation's | Nation’s Giant Hamburgers
cards.access_notes: Official location listing: Sun–Wed 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; Thu–Sat 6:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m.

cards.title: Casa Orinda Friday or Saturday
cards.subtitle: 20 Bryant Way, Orinda
cards.notes: Plan this as a Friday or Saturday dinner destination and use the restaurant’s current-hours page to confirm the 10 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Orinda restaurant with directly posted late-week dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Orinda's official site lists Friday and Saturday hours from 4:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday 4:00–10:00 p.m.; Wednesday, Thursday, and Sunday end at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Metro's 11 p.m. Dining Window
cards.subtitle: 3524 Mt. Diablo Boulevard, Lafayette
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s hours page for same-day confirmation; it lists dining every day through 11 p.m., separate from its bar information.
cards.short_summary: A Lafayette restaurant with an official daily 11 p.m. dining listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Lafayette's official hours page says the restaurant is open seven days a week from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours page lists restaurant dining 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily; confirm holiday exceptions on that page.

cards.title: Fourth Bore Weekend Dinner
cards.subtitle: 2 Theatre Square, Orinda
cards.notes: Visit for food during the posted Friday or Saturday window, and check the venue’s hours page before departure for schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: An Orinda grill with officially posted 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Fourth Bore's official site lists Friday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday closing at 10:00 p.m.; weekday and Sunday hours end at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Rancho Cantina's 9:30 Close
cards.subtitle: 3616 Mt. Diablo Boulevard, Lafayette
cards.notes: Use the direct restaurant site to check its current Friday and Saturday schedule before arranging an evening meal near downtown Lafayette.
cards.short_summary: A Lafayette restaurant with a published 9:30 p.m. late-week close.
cards.evidence_claim: Rancho Cantina's official site lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11:30 a.m. to 9:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday 11:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday hours end at 8:30 p.m.
